standard_prerequisites.name: The globally generated subsheaf lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows the subsheaf F' generated by global sections already surjects onto Q, so F' is nonzero.

standard_prerequisites.name: Duality on proper curves
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns nonzero H^1(X, F') into a nonzero map F' -> omega_X in the contradiction step.

core_obligations: Setup (proof lines 1416-1424): F' generated by global sections surjects onto Q; as a submodule of the rank-1 torsion-free F on a curve it has rank 1, and Q' = F/F' is supported in finitely many points.

Contradiction step (proof lines 1425-1437): if Q' were nonzero then H^1(X, F') is nonzero, giving a nonzero map F' -> omega_X; the image of the composed F' -> omega_X -> F is generated by global sections, hence lies in F', yielding a nonzero self map of F'; such a self map of a rank-1 torsion-free sheaf on a proper curve is an automorphism (standard fact, detail omitted by the author); but then F' sits inside omega_X, contradicting the surjection F' -> Q.
proof_roadmap: Form the globally generated subsheaf and observe it surjects onto Q with rank-1 inclusion into F.
Assume the quotient Q' nonzero and derive nonvanishing H^1 of F'.
Use duality to get a nonzero map into omega_X whose image in F lands back in F'.
Conclude the self map is an automorphism, force F' inside omega_X, and reach the contradiction with the surjection onto Q.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves global generation of any rank-1 extension of omega_X whose zero-dimensional quotient has at least two global sections (statement lines 1407-1414). The proof (lines 1416-1437) is a complete contradiction argument: the globally generated subsheaf with its rank-1 inclusion, the nonzero H^1 producing a map into omega_X, the closedness of the globally generated subsheaf under the induced self map, and the automorphism step (a standard fact the author marks details omitted) leading to the final contradiction. The single omitted detail is auxiliary and standard. H2: a clean contradiction chain with correctly ordered hinges.
